# VSCode i18n Text Converter Extension

This is a VS Code extension project. Please use the get_vscode_api with a query as input to fetch the latest VS Code API references.

## Project Overview
This extension allows users to:
- Select text in the editor
- Right-click to access context menu
- Convert selected text to i18n markers/keys

## Key Features
- Context menu integration for selected text
- Text transformation to i18n format
- Support for multiple i18n formats (t('key'), $t('key'), etc.)

## Development Guidelines
- Use TypeScript for type safety
- Follow VSCode extension best practices
- Implement proper error handling
- Add configuration options for i18n format preferences
